title: Teknofest 2023 Contest – Computer Vision Project
tagline: YOLOv8 + OpenCV for autonomous harvesting (contest entry)
intro: Collaborative vision backend for an Autonomous Harvesting Robot, showcased at Teknofest 2023.
summary: Python + YOLOv8 + OpenCV with a Flask demo UI. Included dataset prep, object cropping, and color detection for ripeness/quality. Trained locally with GPU and demonstrated live.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Contest project integrating YOLOv8 detection with a Flask UI to demonstrate autonomous harvesting scenarios.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Automate detection, classification, and localization to improve harvesting efficiency.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Co-developed the vision backend, built dataset workflows, implemented cropping/color pipelines, and integrated Flask UI.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: GPU-trained YOLOv8 models; custom preprocessing/augmentation; real-time demo via Flask.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body: Heterogeneous datasets handled with augmentation and preprocessing; tuned YOLOv8/GPU for live demo performance.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Ranked 25th; showcased to 2.5M+ visitors; validated feasibility of vision-driven harvesting.
